title: New plant species in Apayao Biosphere Reserve documented by researchers

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY – Researchers have documented another plant species previously unknown to science in Apayao, further highlighting the biodiversity of the province’s UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. More than two years after UNESCO designated the Apayao Biosphere Reserve in July 2024, scientists continue to discover new plant species in its forests. “We are glad we had it declared as a biosphere reserve, which can serve as a classroom for our scientists and a rich resource for researchers to discover previously undocumented plant and animal species,” Apayao Governor Elias Bulut Jr. said in a phone interview Tuesday.
